messages:
Maria (CSM): Reminder: Nimbus private onboarding cutover tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. Final checklist: network egress for SIEM, IAM audit-role trust, HSM CMK policy, and retention window for audit logs. No data-plane downtime expected.
Leo (Infra): Quick sync: log-forwarder will run inside customer VPC and send to their collector over a peered endpoint. We only need egress tcp/443 to 10.200.77.0/24. Omar, can you pre-stage the ACL and flip in-window?
Omar (Network): Yes, I can stage in prod during the window. Will create rule: allow 443 to 10.200.77.0/24 from redwood-subnet-19. Will need cert thumbprint for mTLS allowlist.
Sofia (Customer): I'll DM the cert thumbprint within the hour. Also, our compliance team wants KMS keys to be HSM-backed and a signed key policy before cutover. Legal flagged one sentence in the policy doc.
Priya (CloudSec): Can you paste the exact sentence? We may be able to reword without changing intent. Also need to confirm whether we rotate CMKs at cutover or rely on scheduled rotation.
Sofia (Customer): Legal suggested clarifying the support window clause and adding our contact for emergency key access. They proposed: "Support access limited to notified personnel unless otherwise authorized in writing."
Leo (Infra): That edit seems acceptable. We can incorporate and produce a final PDF for signature. For rotation, we can run an explicit rotate as part of the cutover checklist and capture rotation ARN + audit entry. That satisfies auditable rotation proof.
Maria (CSM): Important: if the signed key policy isn't delivered 48h before cutover we must mark this as a schedule risk that could affect their upcoming renewal milestone. I'm flagging renewal-risk:policy.
Omar (Network): One more note: customer uses an outbound proxy requiring SNI allowlist. Need the collector hostname to be added to the proxy config. Sofia, can you confirm the hostname?
Sofia (Customer): Collector hostname is siem.nimbus-corp.internal (I opened a ticket with our proxy team). Will share proxy ticket ID in this thread.
OpsBot: Pre-cutover dry-run scheduled: commit d4f7 -> staging at 2024-05-16T18:00Z. Dry-run will exercise log-forwarder and IAM assume-role.
Leo (Infra): Dry-run result: canary events delivered to their collector (check link: https://logs.redwood/canary/d4f7). Omar, staging ACL worked as expected.
Omar (Network): Good. I'll apply prod ACL during the 02:00 window once we have final signoffs.
Priya (CloudSec): Regarding IAM trust: sample trust policy posted below for the customer to import. Please ensure principal ARN matches their account and that they include sts:ExternalId if required by their policy.
Maria (CSM): Action items roundup: 1) Sofia to DM cert thumbprint and proxy ticket ID (today). 2) Sofia/legal to sign final KMS policy (T-48h) or cutover delayed. 3) Omar to apply prod ACL in-window. 4) Leo to rotate CMK during cutover and capture rotation audit entry. 5) Priya to validate IAM trust after customer import. 6) OpsBot to run final dry-run 1h before window.
Sofia (Customer): Confirming SOC will monitor during cutover. We're expediting policy sign-off; should be done today or early tomorrow. If not, we'll accept a 24h delay.
Maria (CSM): Thanks everyone. I'll escalate renewal-risk to AM and note potential impact on contract milestone. Posting short SOC-facing 6-step runbook in 30m. Please ack when complete. :white_check_mark:
